Clauses.Title: Services
Clauses.Body: Provider will perform the services described in mutually executed statements of work. Each statement will identify deliverables, assumptions, fees, and acceptance criteria.

Clauses.Title: Fees and taxes
Clauses.Body: Customer will pay undisputed invoices within thirty days. Fees exclude taxes imposed on the transaction, except taxes measured by Provider's net income.

Clauses.Title: Confidentiality
Clauses.Body: Each party will protect confidential information with reasonable care and use it only to perform this agreement. Obligations do not apply to information lawfully public or independently developed.

Clauses.Title: Intellectual property
Clauses.Body: Each party retains its pre-existing materials. Upon payment, Customer owns bespoke deliverables; Provider retains reusable methods, tools, and general know-how.

Clauses.Title: Warranties and liability
Clauses.Body: Provider warrants professional performance consistent with industry standards. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss. Aggregate liability is limited to fees paid under the affected statement of work.

Clauses.Title: Term and termination
Clauses.Body: The agreement continues for two years. Either party may terminate for uncured material breach after thirty days written notice.

Clauses.Title: General
Clauses.Body: This agreement is governed by Oregon law. Amendments must be signed by authorized representatives. Electronic signatures and counterparts are effective.
